pick.name: Reclaim.ai
pick.what: AI calendar layer that auto-schedules focus time, habits and buffers across calendars
pick.why: Automatic focus-time protection and multi-calendar sync on top of Google/Outlook
pick.free_limits: Lite: 2 connected calendars, 1 calendar sync, 1-week range, 1 scheduling link; Starter $10/seat/mo annual

best_free.name: Notion Calendar
best_free.what: Free calendar app showing Google, Outlook and iCloud calendars together
best_free.why: Best free unified manual time-blocking view

alts.what: Calendar + task planner with multi-account support
alts.why: Drag tasks onto a multi-account calendar

alts.name: Motion
alts.what: Paid AI auto-scheduler for tasks and meetings
alts.free_limits: Free trial; Pro AI $19/seat/mo, Business AI $29; page showed 'plan not available' notices

candidates.name: Reclaim.ai
candidates.verdict: PICK: auto focus/habit blocking, works with Google and Outlook

decision: Reclaim is the best way to protect focus time automatically across calendars. Notion Calendar is the free manual alternative. Pick Motion or Morgen only if you want task-driven scheduling and accept the price.
details: Connecting an employer-managed Microsoft 365 calendar may need tenant admin consent.
